units.source_text: 原定舞会毕后，各舞女即留住宫中，充当女官，但此次各人都先回家去。

en.t: Originally, after the dance performance ended, the dancers were to remain in the palace and serve as female attendants, but this time they all went home first.

units.source_text: 近江守良清的女儿赴辛崎祓禊，摄津守惟光的女儿赴难波祓禊，争先恐后地退去了。

en.t: The daughter of Omi no Kami Yoshikiyo went off to the purification rites at Karasaki, and the daughter of Settsu no Kami Koremitsu went to those at Naniwa, so they hurried away one after another.

units.source_text: 按察大纳言也暂把女儿带回，奏请改日送她进宫。

en.t: The Azechi Dainagon also took his daughter home for the time being and petitioned to send her to the palace on another day.

units.source_text: 左卫门督所遣送的舞姬，不是亲生女儿，受人非难，但终于也容许她入宫。

en.t: The dancer sent by the Captain of the Left Gate Guards was not his own daughter and drew criticism, but in the end she too was permitted to enter the palace.
